description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Dex 13+, Operator Style, 3 ranks in Acrobatics

Benefit: When in Operator Style, whenever you successfully hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can immediately make an Acrobatics check to Tumble through an adjacent square the creature threatens as a free action that can occur outside of your turn. You can add half your weapon's weight as a circumstance bonus to the check. You can perform this feat once per round.

system.requirements: Dex 13+, Operator Style, 3 ranks in Acrobatics
